verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's marketplace search (web search page and `vastai search offers` CLI/SDK) lists live rentable offers filtered by GPU type and count, including a `rentable=true` filter. That lets an ML engineer see available capacity by GPU type before renting instead of finding out at provision time. Region-level filtering is not documented in the evidence, and a community report of a Chinese host listed as a US host suggests location data may not be reliable. Missing for 10: documented region/geolocation filtering, explicit real-time availability counts by type and region, independent corroboration that listed availability matches what can actually be provisioned.
